sector.quote: Beauty and Health Retail Specialist under the EVEANDBOY brand and related businesses.

business_description.value: EVEANDBOY is a beauty and health retail specialist operating under the EVEANDBOY brand. It sells through its own retail stores and online via its website, app, e-commerce marketplaces and social commerce platforms.
business_description.quote: The Company's main distribution channels comprise (1) offline channels through the Company's retail stores and (2) online channels through the Company's website and application, including e-commerce marketplaces and social commerce platforms.
